hints.title: Divisibility of Total Sum
hints.text: For the array to be partitioned into three non-empty contiguous slices of equal sum, the sum of all elements must be divisible by 3.

hints.title: Target Prefix Matching
hints.text: Let target be total divided by 3. Traverse through the array maintaining a cumulative sum. Every time the sum equals target, record a completed part and reset the running sum.

hints.title: Three Segment Verification
hints.text: If you can accumulate at least 3 segments that each sum to target, the partition is valid. Return true if count >= 3, otherwise return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) split points (i, j) recomputes subarray sums redundantly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan greedily accumulating target slices requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check divisibility by 3 and greedily count segments equal to total / 3.
complexity.notes: If sum(arr) == 0, count may exceed 3, so checking count >= 3 is correct.
